name: Launch Lab: Projectile Motion
description: Students predict the launch angle that lands a projectile on a target at a teacher-set distance, then launch to test it. The prediction is auto-graded (hits out of rounds); unscored practice shots afterwards let students explore, for example discovering that complementary angles land at the same distance.
author: Virtual Arkansas

parameters.label: Target distances in meters, one per round (comma-separated)
Hit zone: meters on either side of the target that count as a hit
Show a dotted aiming guide and the hint that two angles can hit the same target
